contracts.edge: kt=ks+q+B*ell; q fractional in physical reciprocal columns, commensurate with declared mesh; source-star reciprocal_shift is not ell
contracts.local: A_ts[v]X=F_t(exp(-2*pi*i*ell.x)*v*U_s X); independent adjoint F_s(exp(+2*pi*i*ell.x)*conj(v)*U_t Y)
contracts.density: For X_ts=L_t C R_s^dagger, n_q=weight/Omega*exp(+2*pi*i*ell.x)*diag(U_t X_ts U_s^dagger); output [NFFT,2] with only explicit spin populated
contracts.density_pair: Omega/NFFT*sum(conj(n_q)*v_q)=weight*Tr(X_ts^dagger A_ts[v]); density_gradient uses i(q+G) only on declared density support
contracts.ionic: g_ts[u]=A_ts[v_q,u]+i Bt D Bs^dagger (ps.u)-i (pt.u) Bt D Bs^dagger, summed over every actual atom; no extra atom-q phase
contracts.gradient: moments returns density and positive_gradient[a]=weight*Tr(g_ts[e_a]^dagger X_ts). vdot(u,positive_gradient)=weight*Tr(g_ts[u]^dagger X_ts). dot(u,positive_gradient) is the support-pinned opposite-edge trace-bilinear pairing, not the forward one
contracts.units: k,q,G in bohr^-1; positions and displacement amplitude in bohr; direction dimensionless; local potentials Ry or dimensionless number profiles; g and positive_gradient Ry/bohr; density bohr^-3; Omega/NFFT bohr^3
contracts.weight: caller supplies explicit real sector weight exactly once (actual complete-grid per-cell quadrature 1/64 per explicit spin); no spin degeneracy multiplier
contracts.storage: all orbital/grid temporaries bounded by block_size in 1..16; persistent original species factors allowed; no full-PW-square matrices or global block-diagonal D in implementation; return arrays scale with requested output columns
